purpose: Release a terminated camera source and its worker promptly, clear stale tracking presentation and offer an explicit restart.

contract.source: Bind ended listeners to acquired video tracks and inactive to their stream for the current session. Reject already ended/inactive sources; check source state before each running camera pump, including while a result is pending. Stop aborts listeners before stopping owned tracks; late events cannot affect replacement sessions.
contract.presentation: Source termination clears old vectors/stats, ends all owned capture tracks and the worker, enables Start/sample/settings and explains camera restart without an unrelated AI fallback hint. A fresh sample remains available without camera permission.
contract.verification: Reproduce stale source presentation on the parent with synthetic ended/inactive events on actual browser streams and a silently stopped track. Unit-test startup/running termination, cancellation, listeners and stale events. Retain real WASM/model, timing, geometry, presets and CSP checks; no physical device-removal qualification.
contract.preservation: Preserve scientific JSON, frozen native binaries, prior camera outputs, resolved Cargo.lock and release WASM. No Rust/native/core/GPU changes, compiler runs, sensor acquisition or new SDK/model acquisition.

resources.strategy: Hard-link existing hash-identical vendor files into a fresh E: site. Reuse the release WASM, matching bindgen and installed browser/runtime; keep all evidence and failures.
resources.asset_download_scope: Zero covers local SDK/model acquisition. After publication bounded HTTPS checks may stream up to 32MiB without persisting vendor payloads.

remaining_80_percent: Measured canonical calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying Linux hardware and integrated acceptance remain open.
